page_description: Keys for your own systems (secret) and your storefronts (publishable).
empty_description: Secret keys let your own systems call the admin API; publishable keys let a storefront read what a channel sells.
create_dialog_subtitle: Keys act on their own, with the scopes they're given.
created_subtitle: Copy it now: it isn't shown again.
created_publishable_hint: For a storefront, it goes in its {setting} setting ({file} when you run it locally).
created_secret_warning_description: It works like a staff login with these scopes: store it in your server's secrets, never in a browser.
name_description: Shown to staff, so you know what uses it.
channel_description: The storefront reads and sells what this channel publishes.
revoke_dialog_description: Every call with this key fails from now on. This can't be undone: make a new key instead.
